---
name: first-issue-pack
description: Create implementation-ready starter issues for VenturaVision from the approved MVP and Beta gates. Use when maintainers need small independent tasks that move the scaffold toward a reproducible prototype. Do not use when requirements are still undefined or the issue would duplicate active work.
---

# First issue pack

- Read the current MVP scope and repository state first.
- Create issues that each deliver one verifiable outcome.
- Include exact acceptance criteria expected files or interfaces only when they already exist or are part of the approved bootstrap.
- Separate implementation tests documentation and demo tasks when they can land independently.
- Keep issue size suitable for one focused pull request.
- Mark dependencies explicitly and avoid duplicate or speculative work.
